# ChartKit - Complete API Reference for AI Assistants

> @derpdaderp/chartkit v0.4.0
> Lightweight React charting library with 14 components and 17 themes.
> Zero dependencies, pure SVG, ~15KB gzipped.

## Installation
```bash
npm install @derpdaderp/chartkit
```

---

## COMPONENTS

### Sparkline
Minimal inline trend chart. Responsive by default.

```tsx
import { Sparkline } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<Sparkline
  data={T[] | number[]}      // Required. Array of objects or numbers
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required. Theme name
  dataKey={keyof T}          // Default: "value". Key for numeric value
  width={number}             // Optional. Auto-fills container if omitted
  height={number}            // Default: 32
  color={string}             // Optional. Override theme color
  glow={boolean}             // Default: false. Glow effect
  fill={boolean}             // Default: false. Fill area under line
  strokeWidth={number}       // Default: 1.5
  className={string}         // Optional. CSS class
/>
```

Example:
```tsx
<Sparkline data={[10, 25, 15, 30, 22]} theme="midnight" glow />
```

---

### MiniArea
Small area chart with gradient fill. Responsive by default.

```tsx
import { MiniArea } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<MiniArea
  data={T[] | number[]}      // Required
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  dataKey={keyof T}          // Default: "value"
  width={number}             // Optional. Auto-fills container if omitted
  height={number}            // Default: 40
  color={string}             // Optional
  className={string}         // Optional
/>
```

---

### LineChart
Feature-rich line chart with dual Y-axis, curve types, and area fills.

```tsx
import { LineChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<LineChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required. Data array
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  
  // Series config - use ONE of these approaches:
  series={SeriesConfig[]}    // Multi-series config
  // OR
  dataKey={keyof T}          // Single-series: just the data key
  label={string}             // Single-series: display label
  
  responsive={boolean}       // Default: false. Auto-fill container width
  width={number}             // Default: 600. Ignored if responsive=true
  height={number}            // Default: 260
  timeKey={keyof T}          // Default: "time". X-axis key
  unit={string}              // Y-axis unit (shorthand for yAxisLeft.unit)
  
  // Dual Y-axis
  yAxisLeft={YAxisConfig}    // Left Y-axis configuration
  yAxisRight={YAxisConfig}   // Right Y-axis (enables dual-axis mode)
  
  // Curve and styling
  curve={CurveType}          // Default: "linear". Line interpolation
  showDots={boolean}         // Default: false. Show data point dots
  dotSize={number}           // Default: 3. Dot radius
  glow={boolean}             // Default: false. Glow effect
  showLegend={boolean}       // Default: true
  
  grid={GridOptions|boolean} // Default: true. Grid configuration
  annotations={Annotation[]} // Optional. Reference lines/areas
  connectNulls={boolean}     // Default: true
  onDataPointClick={fn}      // Optional. Click handler
  renderTooltip={fn}         // Optional. Custom tooltip renderer
/>

// SeriesConfig
interface SeriesConfig {
  key: string;               // Data property key
  label: string;             // Display label
  displayValue?: string;     // Badge value in legend
  yAxisId?: 'left'|'right';  // Y-axis assignment (default: 'left')
  area?: boolean;            // Fill area under line
  areaOpacity?: number;      // Area fill opacity (default: 0.15)
  color?: string;            // Custom line color
  strokeDasharray?: string;  // Dash pattern (e.g., "5,5")
  strokeWidth?: number;      // Line width (default: 2)
}

// YAxisConfig
interface YAxisConfig {
  unit?: string;             // Unit label (e.g., "ms", "req/s")
  min?: number;              // Minimum value (auto if not set)
  max?: number;              // Maximum value (auto if not set)
  tickCount?: number;        // Number of ticks (default: 3)
  format?: (v: number) => string; // Custom tick formatter
}

// CurveType
type CurveType = 'linear' | 'monotone' | 'step' | 'stepBefore' | 'stepAfter';

// GridOptions
interface GridOptions {
  horizontal?: boolean;      // Default: true
  vertical?: boolean;        // Default: false
  strokeDasharray?: string;  // Default: "4,4"
  color?: string;            // Override theme grid color
  opacity?: number;          // 0-1
  strokeWidth?: number;      // Default: 1
}
```

Example - Basic:
```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataKey="value"
  label="Revenue"
  theme="midnight"
  responsive
/>
```

Example - Multi-series with smooth curves:
```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  series={[
    { key: 'p50', label: 'p50', displayValue: '1.8ms' },
    { key: 'p99', label: 'p99', displayValue: '5.2ms' },
  ]}
  theme="neon"
  curve="monotone"
  responsive
  height={300}
/>
```

Example - Dual Y-axis:
```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  series={[
    { key: 'requests', label: 'Requests', yAxisId: 'left' },
    { key: 'latency', label: 'Latency', yAxisId: 'right', strokeDasharray: '5,5' },
  ]}
  yAxisLeft={{ unit: 'req/s' }}
  yAxisRight={{ unit: 'ms' }}
  theme="midnight"
/>
```

Example - Area chart:
```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  series={[{ key: 'value', label: 'Sales', area: true }]}
  curve="monotone"
  theme="emerald"
/>
```

---

### BarChart
Grouped bar chart with optional annotations.

```tsx
import { BarChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<BarChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required
  dataKey={string|string[]}  // Required. Key(s) for values
  categoryKey={keyof T}      // Required. Key for categories
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  width={number}             // Default: 500
  height={number}            // Default: 300
  orientation={'vertical'|'horizontal'} // Default: 'vertical'
  showGrid={boolean}         // Default: true
  showValues={boolean}       // Default: false
  annotations={Annotation[]} // Optional
  onBarClick={fn}            // Optional
  renderTooltip={fn}         // Optional
/>
```

---

### DonutChart
Pie/donut chart with optional center content.

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<DonutChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required
  dataKey={keyof T}          // Required. Value key
  labelKey={keyof T}         // Required. Label key
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  width={number}             // Default: 300
  height={number}            // Default: 300
  innerRadius={number}       // Default: 0.6 (60% of outer)
  showLegend={boolean}       // Default: true
  centerContent={ReactNode}  // Optional. Content in center
/>
```

---

### KpiCard
Metric card with sparkline and delta indicator.

```tsx
import { KpiCard } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<KpiCard
  label={string}             // Required. Metric label
  value={number}             // Required. Current value
  data={T[]}                 // Required. Sparkline data
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  delta={number}             // Optional. % change (positive=green, negative=red)
  format={(v)=>string}       // Optional. Value formatter
  sparklineColor={string}    // Optional. Override sparkline color
/>
```

Example:
```tsx
<KpiCard
  label="Revenue"
  value={125000}
  delta={12.5}
  data={revenueHistory}
  theme="sunset"
  format={(v) => `$${(v/1000).toFixed(0)}K`}
/>
```

---

### ProgressRing
Circular progress indicator.

```tsx
import { ProgressRing } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<ProgressRing
  value={number}             // Required. 0-100
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  size={number}              // Default: 120
  strokeWidth={number}       // Default: 8
  showValue={boolean}        // Default: true
  color={string}             // Optional. Override color
  trackColor={string}        // Optional. Background track color
  children={ReactNode}       // Optional. Custom center content
/>
```

---

### GaugeChart
Semicircular gauge with optional ranges.

```tsx
import { GaugeChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<GaugeChart
  value={number}             // Required
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  min={number}               // Default: 0
  max={number}               // Default: 100
  width={number}             // Default: 200
  label={string}             // Optional. Label below value
  unit={string}              // Optional. Unit suffix
  showValue={boolean}        // Default: true
  target={number}            // Optional. Target marker
  ranges={GaugeRange[]}      // Optional. Colored ranges
/>

// GaugeRange
interface GaugeRange {
  min: number;
  max: number;
  color: string;
  label?: string;
}
```

---

### ScatterChart
Scatter plot with optional bubble sizing.

```tsx
import { ScatterChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<ScatterChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required
  xKey={keyof T}             // Required. X-axis key
  yKey={keyof T}             // Required. Y-axis key
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  sizeKey={keyof T}          // Optional. Bubble size key
  categoryKey={keyof T}      // Optional. Category for colors
  width={number}             // Default: 500
  height={number}            // Default: 400
/>
```

---

### ComboChart
Combined line, bar, and area chart with dual Y-axes.

```tsx
import { ComboChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<ComboChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required
  xKey={keyof T}             // Required. X-axis key
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  leftAxis={{                // Required
    series: ComboSeriesConfig[],
    label?: string,
  }}
  rightAxis={{               // Optional
    series: ComboSeriesConfig[],
    label?: string,
  }}
  width={number}
  height={number}
/>

// ComboSeriesConfig
interface ComboSeriesConfig {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  type: 'line' | 'bar' | 'area';
  color?: string;
}
```

```tsx
import { Heatmap } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<Heatmap
  data={HeatmapDataPoint[]}  // Required. { date, value }
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  width={number}
  height={number}
/>
```

Event spike visualization.

```tsx
import { SpikeChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<SpikeChart
  data={T[]}
  dataKey={keyof T}
  theme={ThemeName}
  width={number}
  height={number}
  baseline={number}
/>
```

### CandlestickChart
Financial OHLC candlestick chart with zoom, pan, and optional volume.

```tsx
import { CandlestickChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<CandlestickChart
  data={T[]}                 // Required. Array with OHLC data
  theme={ThemeName}          // Required
  width={number}             // Default: 800
  height={number}            // Default: 400
  timeKey={keyof T}          // Default: "time". X-axis key
  openKey={keyof T}          // Default: "open"
  highKey={keyof T}          // Default: "high"
  lowKey={keyof T}           // Default: "low"
  closeKey={keyof T}         // Default: "close"
  volumeKey={keyof T}        // Default: "volume"
  showVolume={boolean}       // Default: false. Show volume bars
  formatY={(v) => string}    // Optional. Y-axis formatter
  upColor={string}           // Optional. Bullish candle color
  downColor={string}         // Optional. Bearish candle color
/>
```

Data format:
```tsx
const stockData = [
  { time: 'Jan 1', open: 100, high: 105, low: 98, close: 103, volume: 1000000 },
  { time: 'Jan 2', open: 103, high: 108, low: 102, close: 106, volume: 1200000 },
  // ...
];
```

Features:
- Mouse wheel to zoom in/out
- Click and drag to pan
- Crosshair cursor on hover
- Optional volume histogram

Example:
```tsx
<CandlestickChart
  data={stockData}
  theme="midnight"
  width={800}
  height={400}
  showVolume
  formatY={(v) => `$${v.toFixed(2)}`}
/>
```

---

## HOOKS

### useAutoTheme
Automatically switch themes based on dark/light mode.

```tsx
import { useAutoTheme } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

const theme = useAutoTheme({
  light: ThemeName,          // Required. Theme for light mode
  dark: ThemeName,           // Required. Theme for dark mode
  selector?: string,         // Default: 'html'. DOM element to observe
  darkClass?: string,        // Default: 'dark'. Class indicating dark mode
  useSystemPreference?: boolean, // Default: false. Use OS preference instead
});
```

Example:
```tsx
const theme = useAutoTheme({ light: 'sunset', dark: 'neon' });
<LineChart data={data} dataKey="value" theme={theme} responsive />
```

---

### useContainerWidth
Track container width for responsive sizing.

```tsx
import { useContainerWidth } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

const { ref, width } = useContainerWidth<HTMLDivElement>();

return (
  <div ref={ref}>
    {width > 0 && <MyChart width={width} />}
  </div>
);
```

---

### useResizeObserver
Track both width and height of container.

```tsx
import { useResizeObserver } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

const { ref, size, ready } = useResizeObserver<HTMLDivElement>();
// size = { width: number, height: number }
```

## THEMES

### Dark Themes (13)
| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| midnight | Deep black, cyan accent |
| emerald | Black, green accent |
| mono | Pure black, white accent |
| slate | Blue-gray, blue accent |
| arctic | Cold blue palette |
| orchid | Purple accent |
| obsidian | Deep dark, blue accent |
| neon | Vibrant city lights |
| mocha | Warm pastel dark |
| owl | Deep blue |
| retro | 80s neon pink |
| copper | Warm earth tones |
| rose | Pink/rose accent |

### Light Themes (4)
| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| sunset | White, orange accent |
| silver | White, blue accent |
| pearl | Warm ivory |
| latte | Creamy pastel |

---

## TYPES

### Annotation
```tsx
type Annotation = ReferenceLine | ReferenceArea;

interface ReferenceLine {
  type: 'line';
  value: number;
  axis: 'x' | 'y';
  color?: string;
  strokeDasharray?: string;
  label?: string;
}

interface ReferenceArea {
  type: 'area';
  start: number;
  end: number;
  axis: 'x' | 'y';
  color?: string;
  opacity?: number;
  label?: string;
}
```

### ThemeName
```tsx
type ThemeName = 
  | 'midnight' | 'emerald' | 'mono' | 'slate' | 'arctic'
  | 'orchid' | 'obsidian' | 'neon' | 'mocha' | 'owl'
  | 'retro' | 'copper' | 'rose'
  | 'sunset' | 'silver' | 'pearl' | 'latte';
```
